sentences: If you're a creator or business owner getting bombarded with messages across Instagram, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, TikTok, or even your website, here's a hack to consolidate everything in one place.
Most chatbots and AI automations treat conversations separately on each platform and barely understand your business.
So before you spend hours juggling multiple inboxes, try this.
Simply go to SleekFlow, press Start Free Trial, enter your name, company, and website.
Then press Channels and connect the accounts you want to manage.
Now all your messages are going to appear inside one shared inbox.
Next, give AgentFlow your website link, product catalog, pricing sheets, media kit, or any other document that you need.
And now it will know exactly how to respond, what questions to ask, and when a human should step in.
It even remembers the same client across different channels, which is kind of insane.
Comment Agent and I'll send you the full guide and the link to AgentFlow.
beats: It lists the channels where messages arrive, helping viewers recognise the problem.
It explains that chatbots often lack context and conversations are split across platforms, creating a reason to keep watching.
It walks through setting up the service and connecting channels, making the solution feel actionable.
It shows messages arriving in one shared inbox, giving the viewer a clear operational benefit.
It describes adding business materials so the AI can respond with context and know when a person should step in.
It adds cross-channel client recognition, then asks viewers to comment “agent” for the guide and link.
